description: This file defines a feature for listing comments associated with an article identified by slug. It includes a request query object, a request handler that interacts with the database context to retrieve the article along with its comments and authors, and handles the case where the article is not found.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: A record representing the request that contains the Slug of the article.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the request to list comments for an article, interacts with the database context to retrieve article and comments data.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the article by slug along with its comments and authors, throws not found exception if article does not exist, otherwise returns a CommentsEnvelope with the comments.
